stories.title: Iran begins week of funeral celebrations for Khamenei
stories.description: Foreign dignitaries are gathering in Iran for a week of funeral ceremonies for Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, more than four months after he was killed in U.S.-Israeli airstrikes.

stories.title: Dayslong funeral for slain Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei begins in Tehran
stories.description: Khamenei, who ruled Iran for more than three decades, was killed in an airstrike on Feb. 28 at the start of the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran.

stories.title: Iran's control of the Strait of Hormuz remains a powerful bargaining chip
stories.description: Despite efforts by U.S. negotiators, Iran says it wants to charge a toll for ships to pass through the Strait of Hormuz. It's yet another unresolved issue of the U.S.-Iran war.

stories.title: Iran plans dayslong funeral for Supreme Leader Khamenei after war death
stories.description: The country's theocracy hopes to see millions flood the streets of the capital beginning Saturday in scenes reminiscent to the burial of the late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini in 1989.

stories.title: Large crowds gather in Tehran on first day of Ayatollah Khamenei's funeral
stories.description: Ali Khamenei's body will lie in state in Tehran's Grand Mosalla until Monday, before travelling across Iran and Iraq.
